description: BYTEBEASTS is a pixel-art collection inscribed on Fractal Bitcoin, featuring a cast of unique digital creatures born from a lost cosmic network. Each BYTEBEAST is a guardian of a distinct frequency, combining expressive traits, vivid colors, signal-inspired relics, and handcrafted visual characteristics. The collection explores the meeting point between retro game aesthetics, on-chain identity, and the experimental spirit of Bitcoin inscriptions. Every piece carries its own visual signal, making each BYTEBEAST a unique fragment of a larger digital mythology secured on Fractal Bitcoin.
name: BYTEBEASTS
